rules: Canvas does not infer Daughter versions. Exact target versions come only from this governed registry.
Canvas does not fetch or preload protected Work Decomposition or WorkDefinition data.
Canvas hands off only moduleId, exact governed moduleVersion and canonical taskId to the Universal Daughter Renderer V2.
If the exact target tuple is unpublished, the Daughter projection fails closed; Canvas must not substitute another version.
Ocean 0.5 is a historical pre-live Canvas baseline during P4 and is not an execution-depth fallback for Ocean 0.6.
Ocean FCL/LCL 0.6 are the approved production go-live Daughter targets and P4 must route Ocean execution-depth handoffs to 0.6.
The bridge is domain-generic; module-specific version decisions live only in this governed target registry.
Protected execution surfaces remain separately authorized and outside this Canvas bridge.
